I will keep this sorghum plot mostly the way I handled it before, because this plot is very small and cash is tight. On 0.12 hectare, buying chemical fertilizer does not suit me well unless I can share a bag, and in my area many of us grow sorghum with saved seed and manure when we have it. Since I own this land, I will put manure on it, use my local seed in the intercrop, depend on the rains, and do the work with family labor.
